_comment: Ratchet ceiling per locale, from catalogue-audit.ts. A locale's issue count must never exceed its number here -- see catalogue-audit.test.ts. Lower a number (and commit) as a translation batch actually fixes issues; raise one only when Phase 3 adds new keys to en.ts, which every untranslated locale is then 'missing' until its own batch lands. Never raise a number to make a red test pass.
